slides.title: My work, all in one place
slides.body: Courses, commissions and adjustments with colleagues, in a single list — no more jumping between three screens for the same thing.

slides.title: Rates, with the same look as My work
slides.body: Type, date added and currency, all at a glance on every rate — no extra fields to fill in each time.

slides.title: Summary, easier to explore
slides.body: Tap any period on the strip up top to jump to it, and any course to see where the money comes from.

slides.title: Swipe, not just tap
slides.body: Close sheets and go back in Settings and Help by swiping — just like any app you're already used to.

slides.title: More stable end to end
slides.body: Fixed several things under the hood: the bottom bar, end-of-month totals, and user management.
